message: 掲示板には気をつけろ

name: Nanaka
message: 「Your mom said to Kirara, 'Getting into music college is all thanks to Lord Cthugha, so--'」
We turned around at the sound of a shutter.
Azel was standing there with her Leica raised.
Looking sleep-deprived, her eyes were bloodshot.
Azel muttered with a somewhat bashful smile.

name: Synn
message: 「Ms. Melilot passed it down to Azel.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You sure mooched that off her nicely.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「All in how you phrase it, I suppose.」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa. What's with that uncool camera? So lame.」

name: Sally
message: 「I mean, it's way less cool than mine. Look, look, the latest model!」

name: Sally
message: 「I got inspired by Azel and bought one from Demon World Mail-Order too. Traded a beef bowl for it. Arrived this morning.」

name: Misa
message: 「This is a sun-print camera, isn't it?」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez, everyone's picking on me. This is a super cool camera, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, this... You really can't call this a camera.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「So mean! That hurts! That's just cruel!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Why'd you take a candid shot? Take it when I'm posing! You're such a bully. Look, here's my fish-print pose!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh, I see! I'm just overflowing with natural charm!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「At times like this, bad guys are practically guaranteed to be playing with fire.」
We transform as we dash toward the flash!
For some reason, the demons are in a total panic, flying around chaotically.

name: Ria
message: 「The demons are confused! If we ambush them now, we might be able to capture one or two of them」

name: Synn
message: 「Good idea! We can ask them what they're up--」
Azel pointed his Leica toward us.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wh-what was that just now!? My eyes, my eyeees」
With shrieks, the demons scattered in every direction, though the lingering glare left our eyes dazzled too, making it impossible to chase after them.

name: Azel
message: 「I just took a picture of you guys looking like that」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even you know what a strobe is, right, Master Synn?」

name: Ria
message: 「Because a camera can't take pictures in the dark」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh. Right. Good thinking on the spot」

name: Azel
message: 「When I took a picture of them, the brightness seems to have sent them into a panic. That was bad of me」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I mean, you were attacked by those Demons, weren't you?」

name: Azel
message: 「O-Of course I am. Besides, I wanted to try taking photos at night too」

name: Ria
message: 「That camera really came in handy in an unexpected way, huh」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thanks to my grand heroics, I'm just glad nothing bad happened」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I was worried sick! You're so reckless, Azel-san」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Men have a tendency to become wolves with a cub when escorting someone」

name: Ria
message: 「A-A kid all of a sudden?! N-No way, Synn-kun! There's a proper order to these things, you know」

name: Paqy
message: 「You mean a wolf in sheep's clothing」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I won't allow that either as your senior!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not going to become either of those!」
A lively voice echoes through the quiet night academy.

name: Azel
message: 「As if I'd be happy. I have to make all the various adjustments myself, and I can't even see what kind of photo I took on the spot. It's inconvenient beyond belief」

name: Azel
message: 「Yes, full of waste. You even have to buy unnecessary things like film. No matter how you look at it, a digital camera is superior.」

name: Azel
message: 「There is no point in putting on airs in front of you. I...」
Falling silent for just a moment, as if choosing his words,

name: Azel
message: 「Yes. Not being able to predict what kind of photos they will turn out to be has my chest stirring. I am worked up. It is far from calm, yet it is not unpleasant in the slightest.」

name: Azel
message: 「I am excited, with my heart pounding.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. So this is what it feels like. Being excited and having your heart pound!」
Azel's face as he turned back to say that was truly innocent. And adorable.
I found myself wanting to see that look on his face more.

name: Paqy
message: 「Your heart is pounding right now, isn't it, Master Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, why is it always Azel getting attacked by Demons?」

name: Azel
message: 「It is not necessarily only me who is being attacked.」
Is Azel just the only one we happen to be saving?
Then again, there haven't been any reports of people getting attacked by weirdos either......

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Azel. Aren't you scared of Demons?」

name: Synn
message: 「For someone who keeps getting attacked, you're always so calm, and even when you first ran into a Demon in the shopping district, you didn't look scared at all」

name: Synn
message: 「On top of that, you even said you felt bad for flashing your strobe at them」

name: Azel
message: 「Besides, even though I said I'm being attacked, nothing has actually been done to me so far」

name: Synn
message: 「Nothing? Not even a sign that they're going to pounce on you?」
What on earth are they doing?

name: Azel
message: 「Would you prefer it if I got attacked?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm always looking out for you, Azel! I'm genuinely worried about you!」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I see. You're always serious about it」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean it. I really do care about you」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte said it too, you know--you're way too careless, Azel. You don't pay any attention to your surroundings at all, or rather, you're just too oblivious」
I pointed at the bulletin board beside the dorm entrance.

name: Synn
message: 「Do you properly read things like this?」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't. There haven't been any problems so far」

name: Synn
message: 「It says here that dorm renovation work will be taking place from the start of next week on December 3rd through the end of March next year--did you know that?」

name: Azel
message: 「At the very back of the fourth floor.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm say-ing, everything from the third floor up is getting remodeled, so you have to move out while the construction's going on!」

name: Azel
message: 「What?! Why didn't anyone inform me of something so important?」

name: Synn
message: 「They did inform you. Right here. And I'm sure everyone at the dorm was talking about it too.」

name: Azel
message: 「...I don't speak to anyone at the dorm.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh... So where are you moving to?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, wait, it says here that if you apply at the office by November 26th, they'll arrange a room for you by December 1st. Good thing!」

name: Azel
message: 「Phew... Then there is no problem at all. Don't startle me like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, sorry. Still, make sure you at least check the bulletin board from now on, okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「There was no problem. There's no need.」

name: Paqy
message: 「There's nothing but problems. Today is November 27th.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah! Which means you already missed the deadline!」
